metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Kyiv decrease in March 2022 compared to January 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NOAA VIIRS Nighttime Lights Monthly (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG). Compare January 2022 vs March 2022 over a 20 km buffer around Kyiv city center. If a month is missing, fall back to NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG.
2. Masking strategy: VIIRS monthly provides averaged radiance; no cloud masking needed. We rely on the product’s processing. Validate with non-masked pixel counts.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: If reduceRegion returns 0 valid pixels, output C2. If mean is null/NaN/out of plausible bounds, output C3. If no images, C1. Otherwise compare March < January -> A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function getMonthlyImage(geom, start, end) {
  // Primary: Stray-light corrected
  let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')
              .filterDate(start, end)
              .filterBounds(geom)
              .select(['avg_rad']);
  // Fallback: Non-stray-light corrected
  let fallbackCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG')
              .filterDate(start, end)
              .filterBounds(geom)
              .select(['avg_rad']);
  const choice = ee.Algorithms.If(col.size().gt(0), col, fallbackCol);
  return ee.ImageCollection(choice).first();
}

async function monthStats(geom, start, end) {
  // Check collections sizes for reporting
  const colA = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG')
                  .filterDate(start, end)
                  .filterBounds(geom);
  const colB = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG')
                  .filterDate(start, end)
                  .filterBounds(geom);
  const nA = await getInfoAsync(colA.size());
  const nB = await getInfoAsync(colB.size());
  const img = getMonthlyImage(geom, start, end);
  const exists = await getInfoAsync(ee.Algorithms.IsEqual(img, null).Not());
  if (!exists) {
    return {imagesA: nA, imagesB: nB, pixels: 0, mean: null, src: 'None'};
  }
  const src = nA > 0 ? 'VCMSLCFG' : (nB > 0 ? 'VCMCFG' : 'None');
  // Count valid pixels and compute mean radiance.
  const countDict = img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const meanDict = img.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: 1000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const pixels = await getInfoAsync(countDict.get('avg_rad'));
  const mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('avg_rad'));
  return {imagesA: nA, imagesB: nB, pixels: pixels || 0, mean: mean, src};
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const kyiv = ee.Geometry.Point([30.5234, 50.4501]);
    const region = kyiv.buffer(20000).bounds(); // ~20 km around Kyiv
    const janStart = '2022-01-01', janEnd = '2022-02-01';
    const marStart = '2022-03-01', marEnd = '2022-04-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks
    const jan = await monthStats(region, janStart, janEnd);
    const mar = await monthStats(region, marStart, marEnd);

    console.log(`Source (Jan): ${jan.src}, Images: ${jan.imagesA}+${jan.imagesB}`);
    console.log(`Source (Mar): ${mar.src}, Images: ${mar.imagesA}+${mar.imagesB}`);

    if ((jan.imagesA + jan.imagesB) === 0 || (mar.imagesA + mar.imagesB) === 0) {
      console.log('Empty Collection for one or both months.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Valid pixel checks
    console.log(`Jan Pixels: ${jan.pixels}, Mar Pixels: ${mar.pixels}`);
    if (jan.pixels === 0 || mar.pixels === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation & Validation
    const janMean = jan.mean;
    const marMean = mar.mean;
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || isNaN(v) || !isFinite(v) || v < -10 || v > 10000);
    if (invalid(janMean) || invalid(marMean)) {
      console.log(`Invalid mean(s). Jan: ${janMean}, Mar: ${marMean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const change = ((marMean - janMean) / (janMean === 0 ? 1e-9 : janMean)) * 100.0;
    console.log(`Jan avg_rad: ${janMean.toFixed(3)} nW/cm2/sr`);
    console.log(`Mar avg_rad: ${marMean.toFixed(3)} nW/cm2/sr`);
    console.log(`Change Mar vs Jan: ${change.toFixed(1)} %`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (marMean < janMean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
